title: Daily MACD 12/26/9 positive-histogram long/cash timing
thesis: A positive daily MACD histogram may identify strengthening BTC trend momentum early enough that a causal next-open long/cash policy preserves material upside while avoiding sufficiently adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, calculate TradingView-style EMA12 and EMA26 of close, subtract them to obtain MACD, calculate EMA9 of the MACD series, and hold full BTC only while MACD minus signal is strictly positive. Execute a changed target at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: The mechanism requires short-horizon price trend to exceed both a slower price trend and its own smoothed recent state. It is useful only if the default tuple retains material after-cost upside, reduces drawdown, improves Calmar and is supported by annual breadth and rejection-only fast-length neighbors.
